stemMarkdown: Which of the following sentences is grammatically correct?

options.markdown: Having finished the report, I found that the printer had jammed.
Having finished the report, the printer had jammed.
Having finished the report, the jam in the printer was discovered.
Having finished the report, it was found that the printer jammed.

solutionMarkdown: An opening participial phrase attaches to whatever immediately follows the comma. Only the correct option puts a person there; the others make the printer, the jam, or nothing at all the one who finished the report. This is a **dangling modifier**.
